entry.title: I stopped rewriting the official handbook
entry.summary: The handbook at docs.opnsense.org is already the book. My mistake was trying to compete with it. What I needed was a margin: the three facts that stall a first boot, written where I can see them without searching.
entry.content:
The handbook at docs.opnsense.org is already the book. My mistake was trying to compete with it. What I needed was a margin: the three facts that stall a first boot, written where I can see them without searching.

The margin​

The live installer is installer / opnsense. The GUI is root, on https://192.168.1.1/, until you move the LAN. There is no official Docker image. The download is an ISO from opnsense.org/download, and virtual machines are described at docs.opnsense.org/manual/virtuals.html.

The door​

Once the page loads, scripts use the same house. HTTP Basic, key then secret, path /api/<module>/<controller>/<command>/. The how-to I keep pinned is Use the API. The code is github.com/opnsense/core.

I do not need a second product in this repository to have something to curl. The appliance is the product.
